description: List an NFT you own for sale on Baked Bazaar at `price` COOK (creates the auction-house sell order). Simulates before sending; signs locally. Requires COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY. The 1% marketplace fee and creator royalties are taken from the sale proceeds when it sells. `via: "momoswap"` lists a MomoSwap drop's item through MomoSwap instead: the same Baked Bazaar listing, plus MomoSwap's listing fee paid now (1% of the price, at least 0.001 COOK, never more), reported as `listingFee`. Only on request: it is the same listing with a fee on top, so it is never taken on its own.

via.description: omit to list directly (no fee); "momoswap" to list a MomoSwap drop's item through MomoSwap, paying its listing fee now

name: list_nft
title: List an NFT for sale (Baked Bazaar)
